title: "Development"

## Tests

The tests use Pest and run under PHP 8.5:

```bash
composer install
bin/test                 # loads .ext/libphp_stats.dylib when present
NO_EXT=1 bin/test        # pure-PHP descriptive statistics
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/test
```

Most tests compare phplyr with R. The scripts in `tests/r/` run the same
pipelines with dplyr and tidyr and write JSON fixtures to `tests/Fixtures/`:

```bash
Rscript tests/r/reference.R   # single-table verbs, windows, across, tidyselect
Rscript tests/r/joins.R       # joins and rowwise
Rscript tests/r/tidyr.R       # tidyr verbs
Rscript tests/r/rows.R        # set operations, rows_*(), dplyr 1.2 helpers
Rscript tests/r/models.R      # lm() and glm() coefficients
```

## Documentation

The site is a Quarto project in `docs/`. Code examples live in
`docs/examples/*.php`. `bin/docs-examples` runs each one with `docs/data` as the
working directory and writes `docs/examples/_<name>.md` with the code and its
output, which the pages include. Rendering never executes PHP.

```bash
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/docs-examples   # refresh example output
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/render-docs     # examples, quarto render, publish to docs/
```

GitHub Pages serves the rendered site from `main:/docs`.

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `src/functions/verbs.php` | Single-table verbs |
| `src/functions/vectors.php` | Summary, window, and conditional helpers |
| `src/functions/select.php` | tidyselect helpers and `across()` |
| `src/functions/joins.php`, `rows.php` | Joins, set operations, and `rows_*()` |
| `src/functions/groups.php` | Group utilities, binding, and model adapters |
| `src/functions/tidyr.php` | tidyr verbs |
| `src/Vec.php` | The per-group vector expression behind the helpers |
| `src/Ops.php` | Group-vector primitives over the Table contract |
